images.prompt: Cinematic film still, photorealistic, anamorphic lens, rich color grade, fine film grain. close-up on the face or subject filling the frame, shallow depth of field, every detail readable. night rain, neon reflections on wet asphalt, cyan and magenta glow. A furious man in his forties sits behind the wheel of a car in a traffic jam at night, seen through the side window, red brake lights and rain reflecting on his face. Plain dark sky, no signs, no billboards, no shop fronts. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks. No visible hands.
